description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Draven''' throws a fan of axes in a line in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies hit, [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocking them aside]], though not through terrain, and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them for 2 seconds.
